clips.title: The story
paras: Highlord Demitrian is a solitary human hermit dwelling amidst the strange crystals of northwestern Silithus. Describing himself as a loyal servant of Prince Thunderaan, he possesses the esoteric knowledge required to wake the slumbering elemental lord. Adventurers bearing ancient elemental bindings seek him out to unlock the power of the Windseeker.

Found lingering at an abandoned encampment in the Crystal Vale, Demitrian appears out of place in the desolate wastes of Silithus. Though he is tied to the Twilight's Hammer whose ravaged camp he haunts, Demitrian acts above all as a herald for Prince Thunderaan, the Windseeker. He treats visitors with aloof indifference unless they carry proof of the Windseeker's shattered essence.
